description: Calculates the unit price including First-Class postage, total for ready recipients, send date and estimated arrival window for a saved US recipient list. A saved design_id includes that design's current front and back preview. Null design_id produces a price-only quote with preview_included: false. arrive_by adds the latest safe send date and whether the requested date can be met. Does not create an order or charge money.

arrive_by.description: Date the cards should arrive by, YYYY-MM-DD.

design_id.description: Saved design identifier for the current front and back preview, or null for a price-only quote without a design. Required field.

send_date.description: Date to print and mail, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest safe date for arrive_by, otherwise the earliest business day (today if it is one).

name: quote_mailing
title: Quote mailing
